On Mon, Nov 22, 2026 at 9:23 AM Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.com> wrote:
> Dylan — escalating to you as priority (P0) for investigation. Summary and artifacts attached.

Quick status / first-pass RCA:
- Root cause: autoscaler misconfiguration combined with a short burst in inference traffic. The autoscaler thresholds were set conservatively for this model variant; burst caused nodes to saturate and some requests to return 503.
- Evidence: KV cache fill and queue buildup in logs (see sla_incident_logs.zip).
- Mitigation already applied (temporary): increased target replica count for the affected pool and bumped scale aggressiveness. This reduced p95 back near baseline within ~18 minutes of change.
- Next steps:
  - Review autoscale thresholds and rolling policy (owner: Infra Eng) — ETA 24h for safe permanent change.
  - Add burst-protection rule to MAP: maintain 20% buffer for procurement acceptance.
  - Provide a runbook entry for your on-call to avoid mis-triggered downscales.

ETA for a written exec summary and recommended options: 14:30 ET (rishi will draft; I’ll provide the infra section). If Novaplace prefers, we can join the 16:00 sponsor sync to walk through the mitigation and permanent steps.
